definitions.explanation: A common over-the-counter medicine used to relieve pain, reduce fever, and suppress inflammation. Low doses are also prescribed to inhibit blood clotting in patients with cardiovascular disease. The Japanese name is a direct borrowing of the German/English trade name, which became a generic term.

examples.japanese: アスピリン⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{一錠|いちじょう}⟦{飲|の}んだ→飲む：00322_nomu⟧。
⟦{頭痛|ずつう}→頭痛：03369_zutsuu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ひどい→ひどい：01097_hidoi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、アスピリン⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飲|の}んで→飲む：00322_nomu⟧⟦{横|よこ}→横：02984_yoko⟧になった。
examples.english: My headache was severe, so I took an aspirin and lay down.

examples.japanese: ⟦{医者|いしゃ}→医者：02847_isha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{心臓病|しんぞうびょう}→心臓病：04418_shinzoubyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{予防|よぼう}→予防：03669_yobou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧⟦{少量|しょうりょう}→少量：12436_shouryou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧アスピリン⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{服用|ふくよう}する→服用する：21605_fukuyousuru⟧よう⟦{勧|すす}めた→勧める：02120_susumeru⟧。
examples.english: The doctor recommended taking a small daily dose of aspirin to prevent heart disease.

notes:
Originally the trade name of the drug developed by the German company Bayer in 1899; now used generically in Japanese to refer to acetylsalicylic acid (アセチルサリチル⟦{酸|さん}→酸：28620_san⟧) tablets.

USAGE:
- Most commonly used with ⟦{飲|の}む→飲む：00322_nomu⟧ ('to take [medicine]') or ⟦{服用|ふくよう}する→服用する：21605_fukuyousuru⟧ ('to take [a drug], more formal medical register').
- In casual speech, aspirin, ibuprofen, and similar pills may all be lumped together as ⟦{頭痛薬|ずつうやく}→頭痛薬：09711_zutsuuyaku⟧ ('headache medicine') or ⟦{痛|いた}み{止|ど}め→痛み止め：23497_itamidome⟧ ('painkiller'). アスピリン specifies this one drug.
- Aspirin is contraindicated for children with viral illness (Reye's syndrome risk); in Japanese package inserts this warning appears as a standard precaution.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- アスピリン⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飲|の}む→飲む：00322_nomu⟧: to take aspirin
- アスピリン⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{服用|ふくよう}する→服用する：21605_fukuyousuru⟧: to take aspirin (formal/medical)
- アスピリン{一錠|いちじょう}: one aspirin tablet
- ⟦{低|てい}→低〜：03961_tei⟧⟦{用量|ようりょう}→用量：18412_youryou⟧アスピリン: low-dose aspirin
- アスピリン⟦{療法|りょうほう}→療法：13615_ryouhou⟧: aspirin therapy

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{鎮痛剤|ちんつうざい}→鎮痛剤：15451_chintsuuzai⟧: painkiller; analgesic — the general category; アスピリン is one specific example.
- ⟦{解熱剤|げねつざい}→解熱剤：09713_genetsuzai⟧: fever reducer — another functional category that aspirin falls under.
- ⟦{頭痛薬|ずつうやく}→頭痛薬：09711_zutsuuyaku⟧: headache medicine — everyday term covering aspirin, ibuprofen, and similar drugs.
- イブプロフェン: ibuprofen — a different NSAID with a similar purpose, generally considered gentler on the stomach.
